standard: AAOIFI ratio screen on the latest quarterly filing; Zoya is the compliance source of truth

rules.universe: US stocks over $3B in every sector except Financial Services, top 45 per sector by market cap (tech 2x)
rules.business: excluded by industry: banks, insurance, lenders, alcohol, tobacco, gambling and casinos, aerospace and defense, mortgage REITs; blocklist for pork processors and casino operators
rules.ratios: total debt under 33% of market cap, cash and short-term investments under 33% of market cap, interest income under 5% of revenue
rules.quality: positive gross margin, trailing price/sales at or below 25, no P/E cap; net analyst downgrades of 2 or more in 45 days removes a name
rules.momentum: price vs 200-day SMA; Watch if within 5% below, Removed if more than 5% below or below two straight weeks
rules.scoring: percentile ranks: 45% trend (12-month and 12-week), 20% revisions and last surprise, 20% quality (margin, ROE), 15% above 200-day
rules.sizing: sector slots: tech 18, healthcare 10, industrials 9, consumer cyclical 8, others 2–5; sectors are left empty if nothing passes
rules.stability: 50–75 names at all times; a holding leaves only when it fails a hard rule (ratio, business, momentum, revisions) or, at most 3 times a week, when a challenger outscores it by 15+ points
rules.purification: non-compliant income share is not computed here; use Zoya's per-holding purification figure annually
